FDA Chief Mundhe to Act Against Actors Over Pan Masala Ads

Maharashtra FDA chief Tukaram Mundhe has stated he will take action against actors Shah Rukh Khan, Ajay Devgn, and Tiger Shroff in connection with advertisements for Vimal pan masala. Ajay Devgn has filed a petition in the Bombay High Court challenging a notice issued by the FDA regarding Vimal Elaichi advertisements.
